description: This is a test class for the EncryptionUtil utility, containing unit tests to verify encryption and decryption functions within the org.apache.fineract.infrastructure.security.utils package.

classes.name: EncryptionUtilTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EncryptionUtil utility functions, testing encryption and decryption logic.

methods.name: testEncryptDecryptWorks
methods.description: Verifies that data encrypted with EncryptionUtil.encryptToBase64 can be successfully decrypted back to original data.

methods.name: testDecryptWorks
methods.description: Verifies that a known encrypted string can be decrypted to the expected original string.
